entries.title: Baldwins Pond dam investigation works
entries.body: Cognition Land and Water Ltd is carrying out site investigations to inform future improvements to the Baldwins Pond dam. A public consultation is expected to follow, with construction expected to begin in spring (year not stated, presumably 2027).

sourceNotes.source: Wildfire risk / BBQ enforcement (Met Office Fire Severity Index, London Fire Brigade press alerts, City of London's own wildfire-prevention page)
sourceNotes.note: Genuinely relevant to a forest and currently hand-verifiable only: the Met Office retired its own FSI webpage in favour of Natural England's 'Open Access' map, which has no public API found -- it's a map, not a feed. LFB issues an 'extreme wildfire warning' by press release when conditions spike (one hit in July 2026), not on a schedule, so it's an event to catch via news search in dry/hot weather rather than something to poll. Worth a seasonal reminder in the workflow prompt (check during dry spells) rather than a new structured file yet.

sourceNotes.source: Storm/path closures (City of London's 'Severe Weather Protocol')
sourceNotes.note: Real (the Dec 2021 storm and 2024's Highgate Wood closure during Storm Bert/Darragh are documented precedent) but no advance schedule or feed exists -- it's triggered ad hoc by forecast wind speed. Only catchable via a news/social search in the days around a named storm; not worth a data file until a live source turns up.

Free, open, no key needed -- genuinely the easiest API evaluated so far. Covers flood warnings/alerts and river levels; relevant to low-lying paths and ponds near the River Roding/Ching rather than the forest's high ground generally. Not yet looked up which station/flood-area codes cover our coverage settlements -- that's the remaining work before this becomes a real integration.
